Martin Bloice won the Wandsworth Schools 440 yards in 56.0 held at Hurlingham on 15th June and will represent his district in the London Schools. Have heard from Edmund Godfrey, our member at school up at Blackburn, that he recently improved his best mile time to 5:09.
